description: Add a season selector to the SPA (2024 / 2025 / 2026) defaulting to the current year, and make the prediction feature appear ONLY for the current predictable season. For 2024/2025 show a results-only state (hide/disable the prediction panel, surface final results). For 2026 keep the prediction feature and handle the empty/upcoming state. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: In frontend/src/config.ts, replace the hardcoded DEFAULT_SEASON=2024 with the year-aware value from shared: import { CURRENT_YEAR, SELECTABLE_SEASONS } from '@mlb/shared' and export DEFAULT_SEASON = CURRENT_YEAR (2026). Keep the API base URL resolution untouched. Do not scatter 2026 literals.

In frontend/src/App.tsx, replace `const season = DEFAULT_SEASON` with React state initialized to DEFAULT_SEASON, and add a season selector control (a labeled <select> or a segmented set of buttons) listing SELECTABLE_SEASONS. Changing the selection re-fetches the bracket (the existing useEffect already keys on season). Reset selectedSeriesId when the season changes. Keep the offline seed fallback behavior (now also covers 2025 via getSeedBracket).

Gate the prediction feature on season mode using shared's season-status helper. For a results-only season (2024/2025): do NOT render the interactive PredictionPanel; instead show a clear results-only treatment (e.g. a 'Final results' panel or a note that the <season> postseason is complete, with the bracket/standings still fully shown). For the predictable season (2026): render PredictionPanel as today. Ensure the season subtitle text updates to the selected season.

Make the SeriesCard 'Predict' affordance consistent with the mode: in results-only seasons the per-series Predict button should be hidden or replaced with a non-interactive final indicator so a user cannot trigger a prediction that the backend will refuse. Keep selecting a series to view game-by-game detail working in all seasons.

Handle the 2026 empty/upcoming UI: if the 2026 bracket has no in-progress/real series (empty or only placeholder scheduled series), show a friendly 'The 2026 postseason has not started yet' message (or similar) in place of a broken bracket, and the prediction panel should show its idle/no-prediction state rather than erroring. Placeholder team ids not in TEAMS already render via the teamName fallback - verify nothing crashes.

Update frontend unit tests (vitest, e.g. around PredictionPanel and App) to cover: prediction panel/affordance hidden for a results-only season; shown for the predictable season; season selector switches the rendered season. Follow existing patterns in frontend/src/components/PredictionPanel.test.tsx.

Update Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e/: the existing home.spec.ts and prediction.spec.ts assume the default season is 2024 with the WS card 2024-ws-worldseries-119-147 and a Predict button. Because the default is now 2026 (offline fallback has NO 2026 seed), adjust the specs so they are deterministic offline: e.g. drive the season selector to 2024/2025 to assert results-only (no Predict button, final bracket shown via the seed fallback), and add/adjust a spec that selects 2026 and asserts the predictable UI with /prediction stubbed via fixtures (and/or the upcoming-state message when the bracket is empty). Keep all specs green under headless chromium --no-sandbox. Update frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts if the stubbed seriesId/season needs to match 2026.
acceptance_criteria: The SPA renders a season selector offering 2024, 2025, and 2026 and defaults to 2026 (CURRENT_YEAR).
Switching seasons re-fetches/re-renders the bracket for the chosen season and clears any selected series.

For 2024 and 2025 the interactive prediction panel and per-series Predict affordance are not available; a results-only treatment is shown and the bracket/standings still render (via live or seed fallback).
For 2026 the prediction feature is available; when there are no in-progress series an upcoming/empty-state message is shown instead of a broken bracket or an error.
`npm run build` exits 0, `npm test` passes (incl. updated frontend unit tests), and `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` passes.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm exit 0.
Run `npm test` and confirm frontend unit tests pass.
Run `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` and confirm all Playwright specs pass (headless chromium --no-sandbox).
Read the updated e2e specs and confirm they assert results-only behavior for a past season and prediction behavior for 2026, deterministically (offline seed + stubbed /prediction).
findings: Implemented: config.ts now imports CURRENT_YEAR/SELECTABLE_SEASONS from @mlb/shared (DEFAULT_SEASON=CURRENT_YEAR, re-exports SELECTABLE_SEASONS). App.tsx holds season state (default 2026) with a segmented season selector (role=group labelled 'Season'); changing season resets selectedSeriesId and re-fetches via the existing useEffect. Prediction gated on isPredictable: 2026 renders PredictionPanel; 2024/2025 render a non-interactive 'Final results' panel while bracket+standings still render. SeriesCard gained a `predictable` prop (forwarded by BracketView) so results-only seasons show a 'View details' button instead of 'Predict winner' (selection/detail still works everywhere). Added an upcoming/empty state: a 2026 bracket with no started series (all scheduled, no games) shows 'The 2026 postseason has not started yet' instead of a broken grid (hasStartedContent helper). api.getPrediction now returns PredictionResponse; PredictionPanel branches on mode (numeric for 'prediction', graceful message for 'upcoming'/'results'). Tests: PredictionPanel.test.tsx updated for the union + new upcoming test; new App.test.tsx covers selector/default/gating/subtitle/upcoming (used fireEvent since @testing-library/user-event is not installed). e2e: default is now 2026 (no offline seed) so specs drive the selector to 2024/2025 for results-only (no Predict button, Dodgers over Yankees 4-1 for 2024, Dodgers over Blue Jays 4-3 for 2025) and stub /bracket+/prediction for the 2026 predictable flow (fixtures.ts adds stubBracket2026 + SAMPLE_2026 series id 2026-ws-worldseries-119-147). Verified: npm run build exits 0; npm test all workspaces green (shared 2, backend 7, frontend 4, infra 1); npm run test:e2e -w frontend 9/9 passed. Note: grep_search tool failed to index shared/src/types.ts and frontend/src/styles.css this session (git grep worked); not a code issue.
